title: Warsong Gulch Roles & Composition (19)
summary: How the nine Classic classes fill WSG's roles — healer, flag carrier, and damage — and why survivability and coordination decide the 19 bracket. Synthesized from the seeded tier roster and scaling notes; confirm class specifics with `/class` and `/statweights`.

sections.heading: The objective
sections.body: Warsong Gulch is capture-the-flag, played at exactly level 19. Because gear gaps between capped twinks are small, games are decided by **survivability and coordination** more than raw damage. The roles below map the nine Classic classes onto that. Use `/tierlist` for the full role and tier breakdown.

sections.heading: Healers anchor the premade
sections.body:
**Priest** — the premier healer; dispels and Power Word: Shield make it the backbone of a premade, and losing the healer usually loses the fight.
**Paladin** (Alliance) — off-heals and hybrid utility (Blessings, Hammer of Justice).
**Shaman** (Horde) — off-heals and hybrid utility (Purge, Tremor/Earthbind Totem).

Protect your healer and focus the enemy's. See `/class class:priest`.

sections.heading: Flag carriers
sections.body:
**Warrior** (Protection) — high armor and Berserker Rage to break fears; a durable carrier under focus.
**Druid** (Bear Form) — the bracket's best carrier; extra armor and health plus shifting to shed roots and snares.

Both want the stamina to reach the meta's **~1000+ HP** target. Stack stamina and a movement-speed boots enchant so the carrier lives and moves. Check exact conversions with `/statweights`.

sections.heading: Damage and control
sections.body:
**Hunter** — top-tier ranged burst plus a pet; Wing Clip and Concussive Shot to kite and peel.
**Rogue** — a stealth opener with Sap, Gouge, Blind, and Kick control.
**Mage** — Frost Nova roots and Frostbolt slows plus Polymorph, on a fragile frame.
**Warlock** — DoT pressure plus Fear and Curse of Recklessness.

In a flag game, control — slows, roots, stuns, peels — often frees or stops a carrier better than damage alone.

sections.heading: Why coordination and stamina win
sections.body: With everyone capped at 19, fights come down to focus fire, peels for your carrier, and simply staying alive. As a rough guide **1 Stamina ≈ 10 Health**, and in competitive play stamina effectively beats every other primary stat. Coordinate targets and protect the carrier, and the survivability edge closes out games.
